title: v5.4.1 — Outdated Device Auto-Cleanup
message: Each device now records which app version it's running. The Your Devices list shows the version next to each device — green if it's on the latest, amber if it's outdated. Any device on an older version that hasn't updated within 5 days is automatically signed out from your account for security. Heads up: A device only appears in Your Devices once it has loaded v5.4.0 or later — older sessions with no version data also get auto-cleaned after 5 days. Browser/PWA users update automatically on next visit; APK users need to install the new APK to keep their session active. When this device is signed out remotely, you'll see a brief notice before it happens.
